notes.title: Ver. 1.1.16.41 Update (2023/11/25)
notes.notes: Fix an issue that when click on the furniture list, sometimes it will show two items.

notes.title: Ver. 1.1.15.40 Update (2023/11/09)
notes.notes:
1. Add difficulty options, default is Normal. 
In game settings you can choose Easy to enable Cat's double jump to make the game easier.

2. Add resolution settings.
3. Add 10 types of fish.
4. Add 10 Steam achievements.

notes.title: Ver. 1.1.13.37 Update (2023/10/28)
notes.notes:
1. Fix an issue that the cat will slide when switching animation.
2. Limit the framerate of the game.

notes.title: Ver. 1.1.12.35 Update (2023/10/25)
notes.notes: Fix an issue that the rug/carpet layer was incorrect.

notes.title: Ver. 1.1.11.34 Update (2023/10/24)
notes.notes: Fix an issue the cat wouldn't jump on top of wooden boxes or haystack sometimes.

notes.title: Ver. 1.1.10.33 Update (2023/10/21)
notes.notes:
1. Adjust cat's running animation.
2. Optimized the placement operation of furniture. Now you can directly drag and drop small props onto the table.
3. Fix occasional abnormal bugs in furniture hierarchy.

notes.title: Ver. 1.1.6.28 Update (2023/10/19)
notes.notes:
1. Adjust the price of some furniture.
2. Adjust furniture to gradually unlock with levels
3. Added the ability to use the space bar to fish.

notes.title: Ver. 1.1.5.26 Update (2023/10/18)
notes.notes:
1. Fix bug: Items in room are not counted in shop view.
2. Fix bug: Diaries will be recorded in a row in unintended way.

notes.title: Ver. 1.1.3.24 Update (2023/10/17)
notes.notes: Add a diary system, photographing the various moments of the cat's in express delivery and in cat house.

notes.title: Ver. 1.0.13.19 Update (2023/10/11)
notes.notes:
1. Add a new Steam Achievement [Brilliant Starlight].
2. Optimize the cat's behaviour in cat house.

notes.title: Ver 1.0.12.17 Update (2023/10/10)
notes.notes:
1. Add a new background music to fishing scene.
2. Fix bug: Missing sound effect when deliver failed.
3. Fix bug: In some particular case, deliver failed UI may overlay with pause UI.
4. Fix bug: When fishing, cat's dialog text will exceed the box.

notes.title: Ver 1.0.11.16 Update (2023/10/09)
notes.notes:
1. Add restart button to the delivery pause UI.
2. Add delivery fail UI.
3. Replace quit room button image with a new one.
4. Optimize fishing UI.
5. Fix the empty dialog in level 13.
6. Optimize the furniture UI.
7. Fix the untranslated dialog in level 11.

notes.title: Ver 1.0.9.12 Update (2023/10/08)
notes.notes:
1. Fix GPU high usage bug.
2. Fix grid size of furniture [Dark Wooden Large Cabinet].
3. Fix the size of the cat litter scoop.
